steps.title: Inspect and measure the prints
steps.action: Record the reported body fit problem. Print the R04 coupon, one angle and both joint samples. Check both fasteners and the actual tool before full body prints.
steps.measure: Record the failed joint and measured gap. R04 deck side clearance is nominally 0.6 mm per side. The physical fit remains unverified.
steps.evidence: Dimensions and a photo of the measured parts. Retain any fit failures.

steps.title: Assemble the passive parallelogram
steps.action: Use the matched R04 body parts. Reuse checked R03 links and spacers. Body spacers remain lower 2 mm and upper 12 mm. Carrier spacers remain lower 12 mm and upper 2 mm.
steps.measure: Actual spacer and fastener stacks, bolt-end clearance, pivot retention and free motion. Match the printed revision before you use this layout.
steps.evidence: Side and end-view photos. Fasteners retained without binding.

steps.title: Record the observed leg travel
steps.action: The user reports satisfactory travel after the leg tests. Add the measured endpoints, closest clearances and neutral free play to the dated report. Recheck these interfaces after the R03 parts replace the R01 parts.
steps.measure: Axle x/y, closest clearance, rubbing, binding and neutral free play. Do not force a collision.
steps.evidence: Photos at three poses and notes that identify the closest hardware clearances.

steps.title: Check motor and wheel packaging
steps.action: Independently support the received motor at the proposed carrier location with power disconnected. Check shaft, hub, wheel, bearing and cable envelopes across the sweep. Compare the motor with the JD-03 wheel drive mount sheet and its 1:1 carrier template.
steps.measure: Motor mass, boss, shaft, flat, hole spacing and shaft offset. Wheel seat depth when the wheels arrive. Actual wheel and cable clearances. The Ø100 disc represents an envelope only.
steps.evidence: Packaging photos and a list of mount, hub and bearing details still needed.

steps.title: Repeat five hand sweeps
steps.action: After a clear first sweep, repeat slowly five times. Recheck retained hardware and print condition, and approach neutral from both directions.
steps.measure: Cycle count, endpoint repeatability, neutral free play and changes in print condition. No test payload on R01.
steps.evidence: Before/after photos and measured play. Keep the failures in the journal.

steps.title: Qualify the restrained wheel channel
steps.action: After mount, support and electrical checks, pin the leg and lift the wheel. Verify motor/encoder direction, then follow the bounded wheel-only bench trial.
steps.measure: Speed, sign, response, current, rail voltage and temperature. Verify the current limit, kill and fault behavior.
steps.evidence: Wiring/firmware revision, logs and supported fault checks. Start with the full bench guide.

steps.title: Commission one supported driven leg
steps.action: After servo arrival and bare-servo checks, fit the supported 3:1 transmission. Begin the guide’s 28–32° small-motion trial at 1°/s, with catch support.
steps.measure: Ten small cycles, independently measured angle, error, backlash, current, rail voltage and temperature.
steps.evidence: Servo identification, transmission/neutral mapping, logs and deliberate-rearm fault tests.

steps.title: Qualify loading and duty
steps.action: Use a reviewed structure and load path, captured measured loads and a defined force direction/lever arm. Proceed only after the guide’s unloaded, electrical and fault gates.
steps.measure: Load, deflection, backlash, hold duty, temperature and power-loss behavior. R01 alone has no applied-load qualification.
steps.evidence: Dated load/duty session and measured acceptance evidence. This bench alone closes no balance gate.

events.title: R01 passive print kit prepared
events.notes: 110 mm parallel links, 40 mm pivots and separate lateral spacers. Geometry mockup only.

events.title: Motor/drivers received · parts printed
events.notes: User report recorded October 2. Total driver count, printed revision/material and received dimensions remain to confirm. No measured test result reported.

events.title: Mechanical test route opened
events.notes: The passive fit checklist is ready. Start the inspection, assembly, hand sweeps and packaging checks. Every measured test result is still open.

events.title: JD-03 wheel drive mount geometry proposed
events.notes: The axle moves 25 mm rearward of the lower carrier pivot. The carrier R02 goes outboard of both links. The wheel sits on the motor shaft with the Pololu 2674 adapter. All dimensions come from the Pololu drawings and the STEP model. No measurement and no print exist for R02.

events.title: Satisfactory leg travel reported; R03 body prepared
events.notes: The user reports completed leg tests and satisfactory travel. Exact endpoints, clearances, cycle count and load remain unrecorded. The user confirms sufficient adjustable bench-supply capacity. The R03 kit supplies the next supported body and suspended wheel stage. No measured load or powered pass is inferred.

events.title: All R03 parts printed
events.notes: The user confirms that all R03 kit parts are printed. The October 6 setup uses default PLA. Fit checks and supported frame assembly are next. Measured fits, assembly results and powered qualification remain open.

events.title: Body fit problem and R04 revision
events.notes: The user reports poor body fit and missing actuator mounts. R04 supplies a matched three-deck body, electronics mounts and an ST3215 case cradle. Check a small corner sample before full body prints. The servos have not arrived. Physical fit, powered tests and the leg transmission remain open. Recorded spend stays $173.70.
